description: Template for collecting metadata about scRNA-seq data.

Component.description: Category of metadata; provide the same one for all items/rows.
Component.title: Component

Q30_UMI.description: Q30 Bases in UMI; Fraction of bases with Q-score at least 30 in the UMI sequences. This is the R2 read for the Single Cell 3' v1 chemistry and the R1 read for the Single Cell 3' v2 chemistry.
Q30_UMI.title: Q30_UMI

Q30_bc.description: Fraction of bases with Q-score ≥30 in the cell barcode sequences. This is the i7 index (I1) read for the Single Cell 3' v1 chemistry and the R1 read for the Single Cell 3' v2 chemistry.
Q30_bc.title: Q30_bc

Q30_read.description: Q30 Bases in RNA; Fraction of bases with Q-score at least 30 in the RNA read sequences. This is Illumina R1 for the Single Cell 3' v1 chemistry and Illumina R2 for the Single Cell 3' v2 chemistry.
Q30_read.title: Q30_read

alignment_reference.description: The genomic/transcriptomic reference used for performing read alignment against.
alignment_reference.title: alignment_reference

assay.description: The technology used to generate the data.
assay.title: assay

avg_reads_cell.description: total_reads/estimated_cells as calculated by Cell Ranger
avg_reads_cell.title: avg_reads_cell

cell_count_1mL.description: Number of cells in 1 mL of suspension
cell_count_1mL.title: cell_count_1mL

confident_exonic.description: Fraction of reads that mapped uniquely to an exonic region of the genome
confident_exonic.title: confident_exonic

confident_intergenic.description: Fraction of reads that mapped uniquely to an intergenic region of the genome
confident_intergenic.title: confident_intergenic

confident_intronic.description: Fraction of reads that mapped uniquely to an intronic region of the genome
confident_intronic.title: confident_intronic

confident_reads.description: Reads mapped confidently to genome; Fraction of reads that mapped uniquely to a genome. A gene mapped to exonic loci from a single gene and also to non-exonic loci is considered uniquely mapped to one of the exonic loci
confident_reads.title: confident_reads

confident_transcriptome.description: Reads mapped confidently to transcriptome; Fraction of reads that mapped to a unique gene in the transcriptome. The read must be consistent with annotated splice junctions. These reads are considered for UMI counting
confident_transcriptome.title: confident_transcriptome

data_generator.description: Institution that generated the data, i.e. the data processors
data_generator.title: data_generator

estimated_cells.description: Number of cells estimated by Cell Ranger software
estimated_cells.title: estimated_cells

fragment_size_bp.description: Average fragment size of library in base pairs
fragment_size_bp.title: fragment_size_bp

genes_detected.description: The number of genes with at least one UMI count in any cell
genes_detected.title: genes_detected

library_prep_method.description: Sequencing library preparation method or kit used to create the library. If no commercially available kit was used, please select 'in-house library prep'.
enum: Chromium Single Cell Human BCR Amplification Kit
Chromium Single Cell Human TCR Amplification Kit
NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library
SMART-Seq v4 Ultra Low Input RNA
Takara Human BCR profiling for Illumina
Takara Human TCR profiling for Illumina
Takara Human TCRv2 profiling for Illumina
Takara Human scTCR profiling for Illumina
library_prep_method.title: library_prep_method

median_UMI_cell.description: Total Genes Detected Median UMI Counts per Cell; The number of genes with at least one UMI count in any cell.
median_UMI_cell.title: median_UMI_cell

median_genes_cell.description: Median number of read pairs sequenced from the cells assigned to this sample. In case of multiplexing, only cell-associated barcodes assigned exactly one CMO can be assigned to a sample
median_genes_cell.title: median_genes_cell

percent_cell_viability.description: Percent of viable cells in input cell sample
percent_cell_viability.title: percent_cell_viability

platform.description: The specific version (manufacturer, model, etc.) of a technology that is used to carry out a laboratory or computational experiment.
enum: llumina Infinium General Screening Array 24-Kit v3.0
platform.title: platform

reads_antisense.description: Fraction of reads confidently mapped to the transcriptome, but on the opposite strand of their annotated gene. A read is counted as antisense if it has any alignments that are consistent with an exon of a transcript but antisense to it, and has no sense alignments
reads_antisense.title: reads_antisense

reads_in_cells.description: Fraction of reads from droplets predicted by Cell Ranger to contain a cell
reads_in_cells.title: reads_in_cells

reads_mapped.description: Fraction of reads that are mapped to the genome
reads_mapped.title: reads_mapped

sequencing_saturation.description: Fraction of reads originating from an already-observed UMI. Is a function of library complexity and sequencing depth calculated as the ratio of the number of confidently-mapped reads with a valid cell-barcode and valid UMI divided by the subset of those reads that had a non-unique combination of cell-barcode, UMI, gene.
sequencing_saturation.title: sequencing_saturation

software_and_version.description: Relevant software and version used to collect and process data.
software_and_version.title: software_and_version

total_reads.description: Total number of reads in fastq
total_reads.title: total_reads

valid_UMI.description: Fraction of UMI that match expected whitelist of UMI as calculated by Cell Ranger
valid_UMI.title: valid_UMI

valid_bc.description: Fraction of reads with cell-barcodes that match the whitelist.
valid_bc.title: valid_bc

title: ScRNASeqAssayMetadataTemplate
